entities.summary: RuTracker.org is the biggest Russian BitTorrent tracker. It hosts movies, TV shows, books, software, videogames, and other sorts of digital media. It is styled as a forum where each thread is a separate torrent of a piece of media. As of December 2024, it has 15.5 million registered active users, 2.592 million torrents, and the total volume of all torrents is 6.2 petabytes.
